00188 void ScopeGUI::setAudioBuffer(Buffer const& audioBufferToUse, const double offset, const int fftSizeOfSource) throw()
00189 { 
00190   offsetSamples = offset; // this will be a time offset in samples or the first bin for an FFT
00191   
00192   if(fftSizeOfSource > 0)
00193     fftSize = fftSizeOfSource;
00194   
00195   if(tryLock() == true)
00196   {
00197     if((smoothingBuffer.size() > 0) && 
00198        (audioBuffer.size() == audioBufferToUse.size()) &&
00199        (audioBuffer.getNumChannels() == audioBufferToUse.getNumChannels())
00200     ) {
00201       // smoothingBuffer should be interpolation coeffs for each channel
00202       // so Buffer(0.25, 1.0) should smooth even channels but not odd channels
00203       
00204       Buffer newBuffer;
00205       
00206       for(int i = 0; i < audioBuffer.getNumChannels(); i++)
00207       {
00208         const float coeff = smoothingBuffer.wrapAt(i);
00209         
00210         if(coeff > -1.f && coeff < 1.f)
00211         {
00212           newBuffer <<= audioBuffer.getChannel(i).blend(audioBufferToUse.getChannel(i), coeff);
00213         }
00214         else
00215         {
00216           newBuffer <<= audioBufferToUse.getChannel(i);
00217         }
00218       }
00219       
00220       audioBuffer = newBuffer;
00221     }
00222     else if((audioBuffer.size() == audioBufferToUse.size()) && 
00223         (audioBuffer.getNumChannels() == audioBufferToUse.getNumChannels()))
00224     {
00225       audioBuffer.copyFrom(audioBufferToUse);
00226     }
00227     else
00228     {
00229       audioBuffer = audioBufferToUse.copy();
00230     }
00231     
00232     initBuffers();
00233     unlock();
00234     
00235     updateGUI();
00236   }
00237 }

00398 void ScopeGUI::calculateBuffers()
00399 { 
00400   if(tryLock() == true)
00401   {
00402     const int audioBufferSize = audioBuffer.size();
00403     const int drawBufferSize = getDisplayBufferSize();
00404     
00405     if(audioBufferSize > 0 && minDrawBuffer.size() > 0 && maxDrawBuffer.size() > 0)
00406     {
00407       minDrawBuffer.clear();
00408       maxDrawBuffer.clear();
00409       
00410       const double drawIndexInc = min(1.0, (double)drawBufferSize / (double)audioBufferSize);
00411       const double audioIndexInc = min(1.0, (double)audioBufferSize / (double)drawBufferSize);
00412       
00413       for(int channel = 0; channel < audioBuffer.getNumChannels(); channel++)
00414       {   
00415         if(drawIndexInc < 1.0)
00416         {
00417           double drawIndex = 0.0;     
00418           int previousDrawIndex = -1;
00419           float minimum, maximum;
00420           
00421           for(int sample = 0; sample < audioBufferSize; sample++, drawIndex += drawIndexInc)
00422           {
00423             const int iDrawIndex = (int)drawIndex;
00424             float value = audioBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, sample);
00425             if(previousDrawIndex != iDrawIndex)
00426             {
00427               if(previousDrawIndex >= 0)
00428               {
00429                 minDrawBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, previousDrawIndex, minimum);
00430                 maxDrawBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, previousDrawIndex, maximum);
00431               }
00432               
00433               minimum = maximum = value;
00434               previousDrawIndex = iDrawIndex;
00435             }
00436             else
00437             {
00438               minimum = min(minimum, value);
00439               maximum = max(maximum, value);
00440             }
00441           }
00442         }
00443         else
00444         {
00445           double audioIndex = 0.0;
00446           
00447           for(int horiz = 0; horiz < drawBufferSize; horiz++, audioIndex += audioIndexInc)
00448           {
00449             float value = audioBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, (int)audioIndex);
00450             minDrawBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, horiz, value);
00451             maxDrawBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, horiz, value);
00452           }
00453         }
00454         
00455       }
00456     }
00457     
00458     unlock();
00459   }
00460 }

00486 void ScopeUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00487 {
00488   if(scopeGUIref != 0)
00489   {
00490     // only works if ScopeGUI is the first in the in list of base classes!
00491     ScopeGUI *scopeGUI = *( static_cast<ScopeGUI**> (scopeGUIref) ); 
00492         
00493     if(scopeGUI && scopeGUI->isValid())
00494     {
00495       float duration = *(inputs[Duration].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0));
00496       ugen_assert(duration > 0.f);
00497       
00498       int audioBufferSizeRequired = max(1, (int)(duration * UGen::getSampleRate() + 0.5));
00499       int audioBufferAllocatedSize = audioBuffer.size();        
00500       
00501       if(audioBufferSizeRequired > audioBufferAllocatedSize)
00502       {
00503         if((audioBufferAllocatedSize > 1) && (bufferIndex >= audioBufferAllocatedSize))
00504         {
00505           scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(audioBuffer.getRegion(0, audioBufferAllocatedSize-1), 
00506                        samplesProcessed);
00507           //samplesProcessed += audioBufferAllocatedSize;
00508         }
00509         
00510         audioBuffer = Buffer(audioBufferSizeRequired, inputs[Input].getNumChannels(), false);
00511         audioBufferSizeUsed = audioBufferSizeRequired;
00512         bufferIndex = 0;
00513       }
00514       else if(audioBufferSizeRequired < audioBufferAllocatedSize)
00515       {
00516         audioBufferSizeUsed = audioBufferSizeRequired;
00517         
00518         if(bufferIndex >= audioBufferSizeUsed)
00519         {
00520           scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(audioBuffer.getRegion(0, audioBufferSizeUsed-1),
00521                        samplesProcessed);
00522           //samplesProcessed += audioBufferSizeUsed;
00523           bufferIndex = 0;
00524         }
00525       }
00526       
00527       int channelBufferIndex;
00528       
00529       for(int channel = 0; channel < audioBuffer.getNumChannels(); channel++)
00530       {
00531         int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00532         float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00533         float* bufferSamples = audioBuffer.getData(channel);
00534         channelBufferIndex = bufferIndex; // need a copy of this so it's the same at the start of processing each channel
00535         
00536         int bufferSamplesToProcess = audioBufferSizeUsed - channelBufferIndex;
00537         
00538         if(bufferSamplesToProcess > numSamplesToProcess)
00539         {       
00540           while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00541             bufferSamples[channelBufferIndex++] = *inputSamples++;
00542         }
00543         else
00544         {
00545           while(bufferSamplesToProcess--)
00546             bufferSamples[channelBufferIndex++] = *inputSamples++;
00547           
00548           channelBufferIndex = 0;
00549         }
00550       }
00551       
00552       bufferIndex = channelBufferIndex; // store for next block
00553       
00554       if(bufferIndex == 0)
00555       {
00556         scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(audioBuffer.getRegion(0, audioBufferSizeUsed-1),
00557                      samplesProcessed);
00558         //samplesProcessed += audioBufferSizeUsed;
00559       }
00560     }
00561   }
00562   
00563   samplesProcessed += uGenOutput.getBlockSize(); // make sure we increment the sample counter for EVERY block! even if we skip "frames"
00564 }

00574   audioBuffer(Buffer::withSize((int)(UGen::getSampleRate()), input.getNumChannels(), true)),
00575   bufferIndex(0),
00576   audioBufferSizeUsed(0),

00585 
00586 void BufferSenderUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00587 {
00588   float duration = *(inputs[Duration].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0));  
00589   int audioBufferSizeRequired = max(1, (int)(duration * UGen::getSampleRate() + 0.5));
00590   int audioBufferAllocatedSize = audioBuffer.size();        
00591   
00592   if(audioBufferSizeRequired > audioBufferAllocatedSize)
00593   {
00594     if((audioBufferAllocatedSize > 1) && (bufferIndex >= audioBufferAllocatedSize))
00595     {
00596       sendBuffer(audioBuffer.getRegion(0, audioBufferAllocatedSize-1), samplesProcessed);
00597     }
00598     
00599     audioBufferAllocatedSize = audioBufferSizeRequired;
00600     audioBuffer = Buffer::withSize(audioBufferAllocatedSize, inputs[Input].getNumChannels(), false);
00601     audioBufferSizeUsed = audioBufferSizeRequired;
00602     bufferIndex = 0;
00603   }
00604   else if(audioBufferSizeRequired < audioBufferAllocatedSize)
00605   {
00606     audioBufferSizeUsed = audioBufferSizeRequired;
00607     
00608     if(bufferIndex >= audioBufferSizeUsed)
00609     {
00610       if(audioBufferSizeUsed == audioBuffer.size())
00611       {
00612         sendBuffer(audioBuffer, samplesProcessed);
00613       }
00614       else
00615       {
00616         sendBuffer(audioBuffer.getRegion(0, audioBufferSizeUsed-1), samplesProcessed);
00617         audioBufferAllocatedSize = audioBufferSizeRequired;
00618         audioBuffer = Buffer::withSize(audioBufferAllocatedSize, inputs[Input].getNumChannels(), false);
00619       }
00620       
00621       bufferIndex = 0;
00622     }
00623   }
00624   
00625   int numSamplesRemaining = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00626   int offset = 0;
00627   
00628   while(numSamplesRemaining > 0)
00629   {
00630     const int bufferSamplesToProcess = audioBufferSizeUsed - bufferIndex;
00631     const int numSamplesThisTime = min(bufferSamplesToProcess, numSamplesRemaining);
00632     
00633     for(int channel = 0; channel < audioBuffer.getNumChannels(); channel++)
00634     {
00635       int numSamplesToProcess = numSamplesThisTime;
00636       const float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel) + offset;
00637       float* bufferSamples = audioBuffer.getData(channel) + bufferIndex;
00638           
00639       while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00640         *bufferSamples++ = *inputSamples++;
00641     }
00642     
00643     numSamplesRemaining -= numSamplesThisTime;
00644     bufferIndex += numSamplesThisTime;
00645     samplesProcessed += numSamplesThisTime;
00646     offset += numSamplesThisTime;
00647     
00648     if(bufferIndex >= audioBufferSizeUsed)
00649     {
00650       if(audioBufferSizeUsed == audioBuffer.size())
00651       {
00652         sendBuffer(audioBuffer, samplesProcessed);
00653       }
00654       else
00655       {
00656         sendBuffer(audioBuffer.getRegion(0, audioBufferSizeUsed-1), samplesProcessed);
00657         audioBufferAllocatedSize = audioBufferSizeRequired;
00658         audioBuffer = Buffer::withSize(audioBufferAllocatedSize, inputs[Input].getNumChannels(), false);
00659       }     
00660       
00661       bufferIndex = 0;
00662     } 
00663   } 
00664 }

00685   overlap_(overlap < 1 ? 1 : overlap),

00687   maxNumBins(fftSizeHalved - firstBin_ + 1),
00688   numBins_(numBins ? (numBins < maxNumBins ? numBins : maxNumBins) : maxNumBins),

00700 void SpectralScopeUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00701 {
00702   if(scopeGUIref == 0) return;
00703   
00704   // only works if ScopeGUI is the first in the in list of base classes!
00705   ScopeGUI *scopeGUI = *( static_cast<ScopeGUI**> (scopeGUIref) ); 
00706   
00707   if(scopeGUI && scopeGUI->isValid())
00708   {
00709     int channelBufferIndex;
00710     
00711     // keep filling the buffer until it has enough samples...
00712     for(int channel = 0; channel < inputBuffer.getNumChannels(); channel++)
00713     {
00714       int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00715       float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00716       float* bufferSamples = inputBuffer.getData(channel);
00717       channelBufferIndex = bufferIndex; // need a copy of this so it's the same at the start of processing each channel
00718       
00719       int bufferSamplesToProcess = fftSize - channelBufferIndex;
00720       
00721       if(bufferSamplesToProcess > numSamplesToProcess)
00722       {       
00723         while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00724           bufferSamples[channelBufferIndex++] = *inputSamples++;
00725       }
00726       else
00727       {
00728         while(bufferSamplesToProcess--)
00729           bufferSamples[channelBufferIndex++] = *inputSamples++;
00730         
00731         channelBufferIndex = 0;
00732       }
00733     }
00734     
00735     bufferIndex = channelBufferIndex; // store for next block
00736     
00737     // was the buffer filled ?
00738     if(bufferIndex == 0)
00739     {
00740       // do fft and send
00741       for(int channel = 0; channel < inputBuffer.getNumChannels(); channel++)
00742       {       
00743         fftEngine.fft(outputBuffer, inputBuffer, true, channel, channel);
00744       }
00745             
00746       switch(mode_)
00747       {
00748         case FFTEngine::RealImagRaw:
00749           scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(outputBuffer, 
00750                        0, 
00751                        fftSize);
00752           break;
00753         case FFTEngine::RealImagRawSplit:
00754           scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToRealImagRawSplit(outputBuffer),
00755                        0,
00756                        fftSize);
00757           break;
00758         case FFTEngine::RealImagUnpacked:
00759           scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToRealImagUnpacked(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00760                        firstBin_,
00761                        fftSize);
00762           break;
00763         case FFTEngine::RealImagUnpackedSplit:
00764           scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToRealImagUnpackedSplit(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00765                        firstBin_,
00766                        fftSize);
00767           break;
00768         case FFTEngine::MagnitudePhase:
00769           scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToMagnitudePhase(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00770                        firstBin_,
00771                        fftSize);
00772           break;
00773         case FFTEngine::MagnitudePhaseSplit:
00774           scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToMagnitudePhaseSplit(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00775                        firstBin_,
00776                        fftSize);
00777           break;          
00778         case FFTEngine::Magnitude: 
00779           scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToMagnitude(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00780                        firstBin_,
00781                        fftSize);
00782           break;
00783         case FFTEngine::Phase: 
00784           scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToPhase(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00785                        firstBin_,
00786                        fftSize);
00787           break;
00788         default:
00789           scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToMagnitude(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00790                        firstBin_,
00791                        fftSize);
00792       }
00793       
00794       // keep overlapping samples for next FFT
00795       if((overlap_ > 1) && (uGenOutput.getBlockSize() < fftSize))
00796       {
00797         const int hopSize = fftSize / overlap_;
00798         const int copySize = fftSize - hopSize;
00799         
00800         for(int channel = 0; channel < inputBuffer.getNumChannels(); channel++)
00801         {
00802           float *bufferSamples = inputBuffer.getData(channel);
00803           memcpy(bufferSamples, bufferSamples + hopSize, copySize * sizeof(float));
00804         }
00805         
00806         bufferIndex = copySize;
00807       }
00808     }
00809   }
00810 }
